summary: SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT_v1 draft artifacts (research, resolution, materials, sop_modules, production) pass all critical doctrine checks. 21 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json. Registry compliance verified — no prohibited patterns found. Fine Finish Doctrine compliance confirmed. Research corrections RC-005/RC-006/RC-007 applied. 5 minor warnings and 2 informational notes flagged for review. All artifacts remain DRAFT pending human review and spec.json assembly.

issues.description: 7 binary tasks missing defect_tolerance definitions: TSK_TRIM_FLOOR_PROTECT, TSK_TRIM_WALL_MASK, TSK_TRIM_FIXTURE_COVER, TSK_TRIM_LIGHT_SAND_PRIMER, TSK_TRIM_CLEAN_DUST_PREP, TSK_TRIM_CLEAN_INTERSTAGE, TSK_TRIM_PROTECT_TEARDOWN. Defect tolerance is most meaningful for application/inspection tasks (which are covered) but doctrine recommends it for every task.
issues.suggested_fix: Add defect_tolerance to missing tasks. For protection/cleanup tasks, defect_tolerance can be simple (e.g., 'Complete coverage of all protection zones').

issues.description: production.json introduces 'input_group' reference pattern (trim_surface_input_group) instead of per-task required_input_key/paintscope_key for multi-surface tasks. This is a structural innovation not present in the door frame reference pattern. While cleaner for multi-surface specs, engine integration should verify compatibility with this pattern.
issues.suggested_fix: No change needed if engine supports input_group references. Document the pattern in structural_keys.json for future multi-surface specs.

issues.description: TSK_TRIM_CLEAN_TOOLS uses unit_of_measure 'FIXED' with fixed_time_minutes instead of the EA/rate_per_hour pattern used by door frame reference (TSK_FRAME_CLEAN_TOOLS). Both approaches are valid per schema (structural_keys allows fixed_time_minutes) but inconsistent across specs.
issues.suggested_fix: Standardize fixed-time task representation across specs. FIXED UOM is more explicit than EA with rate=1. Recommend adopting FIXED pattern for all future specs.

issues.description: Profile complexity modifiers (simple=0.85, standard=1.0, complex=1.25, ornate=1.40) are from Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine Section 7.2 but are NOT in Modifier_Registry.md. All other modifier values are registered. This creates a gap in the single-source-of-truth principle for modifiers.
issues.suggested_fix: Add profile complexity modifiers to Modifier_Registry.md as a new 'Profile Complexity Modifiers' section. Values: PROF_SIMPLE=0.85, PROF_STANDARD=1.00, PROF_COMPLEX=1.25, PROF_ORNATE=1.40.

issues.description: TSK_TRIM_PROTECT_TEARDOWN uses SF-based rate (500 SF/hr) keyed to floor protection input, but the task covers teardown of all 3 zones (floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent, fixture_covers). Wall and fixture teardown is bundled into the rate as overhead. This simplification means teardown time doesn't independently scale with wall masking or fixture count.
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable for draft. Consider splitting into separate teardown tasks per zone (matching setup task granularity) in future iteration if engine needs zone-specific teardown tracking.
